title: Vật phẩm Sobi Aquarium: vảy, ngọc trai, thức ăn cá + trứng cá, đống vảy, phao câu
decisions: Row 1 are the three manifest icons. Row 2 (prop_fish_egg, prop_scale_pile, prop_fishing_bobber) are scene props from asset/AQUARIUM_ART_PLAN.md §4.1 that need new manifest rows (plan §0.3): drawn now in the same sheet at no extra cost, added to the manifest when the scene is rebuilt. The pearl is white with a pink-lilac sheen so it is not confused with the owner's orange pearls (aquarium-01-scene sheet A).

cells.desc: Fish Scale: a single shiny fish scale, a rounded shell shape in pearly aqua and gold
Pearl: a single round white pearl with a soft pink-lilac sheen, resting in a small open pink clam shell
Fish Food: a small cloth pouch tied with string, little brown-orange pellets spilling out
Fish Eggs: a small cluster of three round peach-coloured fish eggs with tiny dark dots inside
Scale Pile: a small heap of shiny aqua-gold fish scales
Fishing Float: a round red-and-white fishing float with a small top stick
